name: agent-memory
description: Workspace root: unifies the ui/ component library + standalone app and scripts/ dev tooling under pnpm workspaces

scripts.build: cross-env GOMAXPROCS=4 pnpm --filter @agent-memory/ui run build && cross-env GOMAXPROCS=2 pnpm --filter @agent-memory/app run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @agent-memory/ui run test && pnpm --filter @agent-memory/app run test
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @agent-memory/ui run format && pnpm --filter @agent-memory/app run format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @agent-memory/ui run format:check && pnpm --filter @agent-memory/app run format:check
